questions.q: How does Baumeister compare willpower to a muscle?
a: It gets worn out if overused
questions.why: Willpower is described as wearing out when exercised too much.

questions.q: What happens to daily willpower after many decisions are made?
a: Supply becomes limited for the rest of the day
questions.why: The text says once good decisions are used, you're done for the day.

questions.q: What did a study find after participants followed a two‑week exercise program?
a: They made fewer bad food choices later
questions.why: After two weeks, participants were less likely to make bad food choices.

questions.q: Why should goals be compatible, according to Baumeister?
a: Conflicting goals cause stress and reduce success
questions.why: Conflicting goals cause stress, making them harder to achieve.

questions.q: What strategy helps strengthen willpower over time?
a: Use it regularly in small ways
questions.why: Using willpower consistently in small ways builds it faster.
